title: Mixed-complex getfu prerequisite
objective: Freeze the smallest PARI 2.17.4 mixed-signature quartic getfu complex-exponential boundary and implement the connected multiprecision mpsincosm1/mpsincos prerequisite in ordinary source-transparent Python, or produce a precise compiler/resource blocker with executable fixtures.

oracles: Pinned pristine PARI 2.17.4 stage-local source wrapper

handoff.summary: Pinned two actual mixed-signature quartic getfu boundaries and translated the connected PARI 2.17.4 mpcosm1, mpaut, mpsincos, mpsincosm1, and cxexp real-component graph into ordinary Python. CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged paths agree bit-for-bit on all 12 boundary entries for each function, including exact-zero, 64-bit, ordinary Taylor, and severe pi-cancellation cases whose outputs grow to 640 bits. The focused native graph compiles to a 5,373,955-byte core.
risks: The prepared mpcosm1 cut explicitly rejects the source's exponent-greater-than-30 quotient branch and working precision beyond 2048 bits; neither occurs in the frozen getfu boundary.
This prerequisite stops at exact complex exponentiation. General 4x4 RgM_solve_realimag and quartic algebraic reconstruction/inverse/norm authentication remain downstream.
next_steps: Compose the exact cxexp boundary with a separately frozen 4x4 real/imag solve and quartic unit reconstruction lane.
